source.event-stream.note: An asynchronous, scalable messaging service in which publishers send events without regard to how they are processed and Pub/Sub delivers them to every service that reacts, with latencies typically around 100 milliseconds.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Used for streaming analytics and data integration pipelines that load and distribute data. Processing is left to the subscribing services.

presentation.tagline: Global event messaging that decouples producers from consumers.
